quality_findings.detail: One unique video appears twice; source order is preserved. Avoid automatically counting the duplicate as a second required learning activity.
The source title is a youtu.be URL pointing to tH-7EL0kpVg at position 26. The actual video ID and duration differ; it is not classified as duplicate content without review.

Roman-numbered HRM modules and Arabic-numbered modules appear together. Some Module I entries occur after Module III, Module 4 Negotiation follows Module 5 entries, and Module 6 Introduction follows Flexibility. Preserve original source order and review any proposed learner sequence separately.

Publisher description estimates 6 instructional hours; listed duration is 7:19:04 including the duplicate and 7:05:36 for unique video IDs. These measures need not be identical, but neither proves contact hours or workload.
Source title says SCAT Goals. Do not silently replace it with SMART or expand the acronym without content review.

proposed_learning_outcomes.statement: Explain foundational HR functions and use strategy, workforce planning, and ethics to analyze an organizational people-management problem.
proposed_learning_outcomes.mapping_basis: Observed video titles and publisher module labels; lesson content and transcripts have not been reviewed.
proposed_learning_outcomes.proposed_assessment: A strategic HR scenario response with SWOT analysis, workforce objectives, ethical considerations, and a justified recommendation.

proposed_learning_outcomes.statement: Develop a job analysis and role description and justify relevant compensation and benefits choices.
proposed_learning_outcomes.mapping_basis: Observed video titles and publisher module labels; lesson content and transcripts have not been reviewed.
proposed_learning_outcomes.proposed_assessment: A job-analysis worksheet, draft role description, and compensation/benefits rationale using an explicitly fictional or anonymized case.

proposed_learning_outcomes.statement: Design and justify recruitment and selection steps, accounting for organizational conditions and global staffing considerations.
proposed_learning_outcomes.mapping_basis: Observed video titles and publisher module labels; lesson content and transcripts have not been reviewed.
proposed_learning_outcomes.proposed_assessment: A recruitment plan, selection criteria, structured interview guide, and explanation of global-context considerations.

proposed_learning_outcomes.statement: Create an employee onboarding and development plan with training measures and a performance-feedback approach.
proposed_learning_outcomes.mapping_basis: Observed video titles and publisher module labels; lesson content and transcripts have not been reviewed.
proposed_learning_outcomes.proposed_assessment: An onboarding/training plan with intended outcomes, evaluation measures, and a proposed performance-feedback process.

proposed_learning_outcomes.statement: Evaluate employee relations, negotiation, workplace flexibility, and social responsibility in an integrated HR case.
proposed_learning_outcomes.mapping_basis: Observed video titles and publisher module labels; lesson content and transcripts have not been reviewed.
proposed_learning_outcomes.proposed_assessment: An integrated HR action plan with a negotiation approach, flexibility options, social-responsibility rationale, and a short learner reflection.
